visual.description: Counter scene showing synthetic microfiber persistence in natural environments. Main counter ticks up to 1,200 (years) with subtitle context. Breakdown bars compare the range (58-1200 years) with human lifespan (80 years) for visceral impact.
visual.sourceText: Source: De Falco et al., Scientific Reports, 2019

dataChart.title: Synthetic Microfiber Persistence
dataChart.subtitle: Estimated degradation time in natural environments

notes: Counter format better suits a single dramatic stat than a lone bar chart. The breakdown bars show the range (58-1200 years) with human lifespan (80 years) as reference — making the persistence tangible. Log-scale bars will be used automatically since the range is extreme.
